name: Boise Metal Works
old_description: Since 1994, Boise Metal Works has grown from an idea to a well-rounded industry leader that prides itself on the knowledge and expertise of its employees. Continuing to focus on their reputation for superior quality and customer service throughout Idaho and Eastern Oregon!
about:
Boise Metal Works was founded in 1994 in Boise, Idaho. The company began as an idea and has grown into a well-rounded industry leader serving Idaho and Eastern Oregon.

The shop provides full-service metal fabrication including structural, architectural, and decorative work. Capabilities span welding (hardwire, dual shield, TIG, stick) in both shop and field settings, CNC water jet cutting, machining, powder coating, and pre‑assembly with test runs before shipment. They produce custom metal signs, truck accessories and tanks, awnings, gates, fences, stairs, railing, and fabricated steel tanks, handling projects from small machine components to large architectural installations.

Customers range from construction contractors to aerospace suppliers. Aero Specialties, an aerospace company, has relied on Boise Metal Works for design and manufacture of aero products and weld‑shop components. Other clients have commissioned custom stair rails, deck wall frames, and various architectural metalwork across the region.

The company emphasizes a dedicated point of contact for each project from design through delivery, and the ability to work in carbon steel, stainless steel, or aluminum per customer specification. Its reputation is built on employee expertise, quality, and responsive service.
